title: Caixa Offers Pix Installment Payments
subtitle: New feature for individual customers
excerpt: Caixa offers installment payments for Pix transfers and payments
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Caixa Econômica is offering individual customers the option to pay for transfers and payments made through Pix in installments.

This new feature is available for transactions made directly through the CAIXA App.

Feature

The Pix installment payment feature allows individual customers to split their transactions into installments.

This can be useful for those who need to make large payments or transfers but don't have all the money available at once.

  • Transfer installments
  • Payment installments

Caixa Econômica offers this feature to make using Pix easier and more flexible for its customers.

With information from Agência Brasil.
